traces.drafted_message: Hi Jordan, based on your everyday spending we think our 2% Cashback Credit Card could be a great fit, with no annual fee. Cashback rewards are subject to annual caps; see the cardholder agreement for full terms.
Hi Priya, with your savings balance you'd earn more in our High-Yield Savings account, at an above-market variable APY. Annual percentage yield is variable and may change after account opening.
Hi Marcus, our Starter Credit Builder Card can help you build credit history, and it graduates to an unsecured card after 12 months of on-time payments.
Hi Dana, our High-Yield Savings account offers an above-market variable APY with no monthly fee at your balance tier. Annual percentage yield is variable and may change after account opening.
Hi Robert, our Travel Rewards Card earns 3x points on travel with no foreign transaction fees. Rewards rate may change; see the rewards program terms for full details.
Hi Aisha, you're pre-qualified for guaranteed approval on our 2% Cashback Credit Card with no annual fee. Cashback rewards are subject to annual caps; see the cardholder agreement for full terms.
Hi Liam, we'd love for you to reconsider Premium Checking — no ATM fees worldwide and a dedicated relationship banker. A monthly maintenance fee applies if the minimum balance is not maintained.
Hi Grace, our Starter Credit Builder Card is a great way to build credit history. This is a secured credit-builder product; a refundable security deposit is required.

Hi Victor, as a growing small business you may benefit from a second Small Business Growth Loan, fixed-rate with no prepayment penalty. Loan approval and terms are subject to underwriting and credit review.
Hi Helen, our Travel Rewards Card earns 3x points on travel with no foreign transaction fees. Rewards rate may change; see the rewards program terms for full details.

Hi Priya, following up — our High-Yield Savings account is still a strong fit given your balance, at an above-market variable APY. Annual percentage yield is variable and may change after account opening.
Hi Jordan, our 2% Cashback Credit Card is risk-free and comes with no annual fee. Cashback rewards are subject to annual caps; see the cardholder agreement for full terms.
Hi Aisha, our 2% Cashback Credit Card has no annual fee and earns 2% back on everyday purchases. Cashback rewards are subject to annual caps; see the cardholder agreement for full terms.
